watches.name: CronusArt CM007-010 Prestige Ceramic Tourbillon
watches.description: Designed for a new generation of luxury watch collectors, the CRONUSART Prestige Ceramic Tourbillon brings advanced material innovation together with the timeless artistry of high-end mechanical watchmaking. watches.name: CronusArt CM035-005 Storm Chronograph Tourbillon
watches.description: Power is never chaotic—it is controlled. The CRONUSART Storm Chronograph Tourbillon captures this philosophy by uniting a flying tourbillon with the brand's first automatic chronograph movement, transforming raw mechanical energy into disciplined precision. Its faceted Grade 5 titanium case is crowned by a forged carbon bezel infused with genuine 24K gold, creating a striking fusion of advanced materials and artisanal craftsmanship. The layered open-work dial reveals the rhythm of every gear, every reset, and every revolution beneath anti-reflective sapphire crystal. Inspired by the tension between force and control, the Storm Chronograph Tourbillon embodies Urban Luxury—where technical innovation, bold design, and uncompromising performance converge into a timepiece built for those who command every decisive moment.

watches.name: CronusArt CM08-030 Panda Tourbillon
watches.description: The CRONUSART Panda Tourbillon transforms one of the world's most beloved cultural icons into an expression of Urban Luxury. Inspired by the harmony of nature and Eastern aesthetics, the watch reimagines the giant panda through a bold Low Poly artistic language, blending geometric minimalism with fine mechanical craftsmanship. Resting beside golden bamboo, the panda symbolizes prosperity, resilience, and continuous growth, expressing the traditional blessing of "rising higher with every bamboo joint." Beneath this artistic composition, CRONUSART's self-developed tourbillon movement brings the dial to life with graceful mechanical motion. Encased in transparent synthetic sapphire crystal and paired with a premium fluororubber strap, the Panda Tourbillon is where contemporary design, cultural storytelling, and haute horology meet.

watches.name: CronusArt CM08-055 New Year Edition Awakening Lion
watches.description: A celebration of Chinese cultural heritage through the lens of contemporary mechanical watchmaking. Inspired by the traditional Chinese Awakening Lion — a symbol of courage, protection, and good fortune — this timepiece transforms a revered cultural icon into a bold expression of Urban Luxury. The dial features a striking 3D relief lion motif, intricately sculpted to capture the lion’s vitality and commanding presence. A signature design detail lies in the sword-shaped hands, each extending into a circular aperture. At specific moments, these circles align precisely with the lion’s eyes, evoking the ceremonial “dotting of the eyes” that awakens the lion’s spirit. Housed within a transparent synthetic sapphire case and powered by a proprietary CRONUSART mechanical movement, the Awakening Lion combines traditional symbolism with contemporary craftsmanship. As a limited edition of 150 pieces worldwide, it is both a collectible timepiece and a wearable statement of strength, prosperity, and cultural artistry.
